instruction_en: Turn left from your current position to face a hallway. Walk straight down the hallway, passing a bathroom doorway on your left. Go through the doorway at the end of the hallway to enter a large open room. Walk straight through this room, keeping the dining table on your right, and continue past a living room area also on your right. Enter the hallway ahead of you. Walk straight down this hallway, passing an open doorway on your left. At the end of the hallway, turn right, then walk straight past the bathroom on your left. Enter the bedroom ahead, and stop in front of the bed.
